summary: FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. provides less-than-truckload freight transportation services in the United States and internationally. The company offers FedEx Freight Priority services, including next-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 600 miles and second-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 1,600 miles and backed by a money-back service guarantee if published delivery commitments are not met; and FedEx Freight Economy. It also provides surface expedite and white glove services; and LTL Select, a cloud-based transportation management system. In addition, the company offers volume and custom critical services, FedEx Freight Direct, and Retail Flex. It provides its services under the FedEx and FedEx Freight names. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
summary_zh: FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. 在美國和國際範圍內提供零擔貨運服務。該公司提供 FedEx Freight Priority 服務，包括為行程不超過 600 英里的貨件提供下一工作日服務，為行程不超過 1,600 英里的貨件提供第二個工作日服務，並在未達到公佈的交付承諾的情況下提供退款服務保證；和聯邦快遞貨運經濟。它還提供地面加急和白手套服務； LTL Select，一個基於雲端的運輸管理系統。此外，該公司還提供大量和客製化關鍵服務、FedEx Freight Direct 和 Retail Flex。它以 FedEx 和 FedEx Freight 名稱提供服務。該公司成立於 2025 年，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

overview.en: Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, FedEx Freight is the largest North American less-than-truckload ("LTL") freight carrier, with industry-leading transit times and service levels, offering choice, simplicity, and reliability to meet the needs of LTL shippers while operating ethically with a commitment to "Safety Above All." As of June 1, 2026, we had approximately 40,000 employees, over 365 locations, including approximately 355 shipping terminals (over 320 of which are in the United States) and approximately 10 linehaul relay sites, and nearly 30,000 motorized vehicles, of which nearly 17,000 are tractors, across all 50 U.S. states, Canada, and Mexico. We also offer freight delivery service to most points in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Our robust network established through almost 60 years of operations and consisting of more than 26,000 service center doors strategically
overview.zh: 聯邦快遞貨運總部位於田納西州孟菲斯，是北美最大的零擔 (“LTL”) 貨運承運商，擁有行業領先的運輸時間和服務水平，提供選擇、簡單性和可靠性，以滿足零擔托運人的需求，同時以“安全高於一切”的承諾以道德方式運營。截至 2026 年 6 月 1 日，我們在美國所有 50 個州、加拿大和墨西哥擁有約 40,000 名員工、超過 365 個地點，包括約 355 個貨運碼頭（其中 320 多個在美國）和約 10 個長途中繼站點，以及近 30,000 多個在美國）和約 10 個長途中繼站點，以及近 30,000 輛汽車，其中近 7,000 輛機動車輛。我們也提供前往波多黎各和美屬維京群島大部分地點的貨運服務。我們透過近 60 年的營運建立了強大的網路，策略性地包括 26,000 多個服務中心

overview.en: Our LTL portfolio consists of two complementary service offerings designed to address distinct customer shipping requirements, serving both time-critical and cost-sensitive freight across a single integrated network:
overview.zh: 我們的 LTL 產品組合由兩種互補的服務產品組成，旨在滿足不同的客戶運輸需求，透過單一整合網路為時間緊迫且成本敏感的貨運提供服務：

overview.en: FedEx Freight Priority: A premium, time-definite LTL service designed for shipments requiring the fastest available transit. Priority offers industry-leading published transit times, including next-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 600 miles and second-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 1,600 miles. The service provides broad coverage across the United States, Canada, and Mexico and is backed by a money-back service guarantee if published delivery commitments are not met, providing customers with a high degree of reliability for time-critical freight.
overview.zh: FedEx Freight Priority：優質、限時零擔服務，專為需要最快可用運輸的貨件而設計。 Priority 提供業界領先的公佈運輸時間，包括針對行程不超過 600 英里的貨件提供下一工作日服務，以及針對行程不超過 1,600 英里的貨件提供第二個工作日服務。該服務涵蓋美國、加拿大和墨西哥，如果未滿足公佈的交付承諾，則提供退款服務保證，為客戶提供高度可靠的時間緊迫的貨運服務。

customers.en: We provide services to approximately 108,000 active customers across a broad range of sizes, end-markets, and geographies. In 2026, our top five and top 25 customers accounted for just 9% and 21% of our revenue, respectively. Our largest customer accounted for approximately 4% of our revenue in 2026.
customers.zh: 我們為約 108,000 名不同規模、不同終端市場和地理區域的活躍客戶提供服務。 2026年，我們的前五名和前25名客戶分別僅占我們收入的9%和21%。 2026 年，我們最大的客戶約占我們收入的 4%。

customers.en: We are a long-term, critical supply chain partner to a diverse customer base including large, market-leading national players in addition to regional companies and/or SMBs. A large number of our customers operate in sectors that we believe are poised for long-term structural growth, such as e-commerce, advanced manufacturing, and healthcare logistics. Additionally, we believe that our relationship with our customers through a dedicated LTL salesforce allows us to truly understand our customers' challenges to provide tailored and effective solutions. Our cross-border capabilities in Canada and Mexico, along with partnerships for less-than-container load shipments in Europe and Asia, support efficient international logistics.
customers.zh: 我們是多元化客戶群的長期、重要的供應鏈合作夥伴，其中包括市場領先的大型國內企業以及區域公司和/或中小型企業。我們的許多客戶所在的行業都有望實現長期結構性成長，例如電子商務、先進製造和醫療保健物流。此外，我們相信，透過專門的零擔銷售團隊與客戶建立的關係使我們能夠真正了解客戶的挑戰，從而提供量身定制的有效解決方案。我們在加拿大和墨西哥的跨境能力，以及在歐洲和亞洲的拼箱運輸合作夥伴關係，支持高效的國際物流。

competition.en: Despite several strategic combinations in our industry in recent years, shippers continue to have a wide range of options for their LTL freight. The strength and size of our network enable us to deliver high-quality service, speed, geographic coverage, responsiveness, and flexibility.
competition.zh: 儘管近年來我們行業進行了多次策略合併，托運人仍然有多種零擔貨運選擇。我們網路的實力和規模使我們能夠提供高品質的服務、速度、地理覆蓋範圍、回應能力和靈活性。

competition.en: Our competitors include local, regional, and national LTL carriers, as well as a range of other transportation and logistics providers. We compete with publicly listed, national-scale LTL carriers, along with numerous smaller-scale national and regional carriers. In addition, we face competition from truckload carriers, small package carriers, private fleets, final mile and expedited delivery providers, railroads, air freight carriers, third-party logistics providers, and emerging digital freight platforms. Some of these competitors have larger customer bases, greater resources, or longer operating histories in certain markets than we do. We believe our size and scale strategically positions us in our industry.
competition.zh: 我們的競爭對手包括本地、區域和國家零擔承運商，以及一系列其他運輸和物流提供者。我們與上市的全國性零擔承運商以及眾多規模較小的全國性和地區性承運商競爭。此外，我們還面臨來自整車承運商、小型包裹承運商、私人車隊、最後一英里和加急送貨提供商、鐵路、航空貨運承運商、第三方物流提供商和新興數位貨運平台的競爭。其中一些競爭對手比我們擁有更大的客戶群、更多的資源或在某些市場上更長的經營歷史。我們相信我們的規模和規模對我們在產業中的戰略地位具有戰略意義。
